title: Exterior derivative commutes with parametric integrals over [0, 1]
statement:
Let N, k ∈ ℕ and let h : ℝ × ℝ^N → Λ^k(ℝ^N) be C^∞, i.e. h : ℝ × Euclid N → Covector (Euclid N) k with ContDiff ℝ ⊤ h. Here Λ^k(ℝ^N) is the space of continuous alternating k-forms, which is finite-dimensional and hence a complete normed space. Then for every x ∈ ℝ^N,
 d(y ↦ ∫_0^1 h(t, y) dt)(x) = ∫_0^1 d(y ↦ h(t, y))(x) dt,
where d is the exterior derivative (SimonGMT exteriorDerivative = Mathlib extDeriv). Both integrals are interval integrals over [0, 1], in Λ^k(ℝ^N) on the left and in Λ^{k+1}(ℝ^N) on the right.
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (h : ℝ × Euclid N → Covector (Euclid N) k), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) h → ∀ x : Euclid N, exteriorDerivative (fun y : Euclid N => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, h (t, y)) x = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, exteriorDerivative (fun y : Euclid N => h (t, y)) x
